title: Polynomial-time many-one reducibility
statement: A language $L_1$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to a language $L_2$ if there is a polynomial-time map $f$ on binary strings such that, for every binary string $x$, $x\in L_1$ if and only if $f(x)\in L_2$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a polynomial-time map on binary strings
For every input, membership in the source language is equivalent to membership of its image in the target language
